source.author: verg
source.text: Quid miseros totiens in aperta pericula cives proicis, O Latio caput horum et causa malorum?
source.text_original: Quid miseros totiens in aperta pericula cives / proicis, O Latio caput horum et causa malorum?
source.text_english: Why do you so often hurl wretched citizens into open dangers, O head and cause of these evils in Latium?

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: sed repetam longe altius, ut si quis ad legendum ueri expers et ignarus accesserit, instruatur atque intellegat quod tandem sit caput horum et causa malorum, et lumine accepto suos ac totius generis humani perspiciat errores.
reuse.text_original: sed repetam longe altius, ut si quis ad legendum ueri expers et ignarus accesserit, instruatur atque intellegat quod tandem sit caput horum et causa malorum, et lumine accepto suos ac totius generis humani perspiciat errores.
reuse.text_english: But I will go back much further, so that if anyone, lacking knowledge of the truth, has come to read, he may be instructed and understand what at last is the source and cause of these evils, and, with the light received, may perceive his own errors and those of the whole human race.
